The posts on ondo are information: numbers calculated from public data and ways to read those numbers. They are not a recommendation to buy or sell any product.

Investment decisions

  • Investment decisions and their results belong to the person who makes them.
  • The person who runs this blog is not a financial professional or a registered investment adviser. Before an important decision, please check official sources and consult a professional.
  • Past returns, drawdowns and dividend records are only past records. There is no guarantee they will be the same in the future.

Numbers and data

  • Numbers are calculated from public data (Yahoo Finance, EIA, KOSIS and others) as of the reference date stated in each post. If a data provider corrects a value or updates it late, it may differ from the number in the post.
  • Unless stated otherwise, returns are price returns excluding dividends, and taxes, currency exchange fees and trading costs are not included.
  • Tax explanations describe the Korean rules at the time of writing. Tax laws can change, so please check official guidance (such as the Korean National Tax Service) before filing. Rules in other countries may be different.

External links

The content of linked articles and external websites is the responsibility of each outlet and website.

If you find an error, please let us know through the contact page. We will check it, correct it, and note the correction in the post.
